confirmed_finding.trigger: Initial asset-state read starts before any asset dialog exists; another financial dialog opens while actual state response is held. Old stamp had only API generation/render; no prior asset-marker existed to trigger module clear. Late response replaced the newer dialog.
confirmed_finding.impact: Context/interaction failure, not a demonstrated authorization or financial write bypass.
confirmed_finding.owner_fix: Global dialogGeneration increments on closeModal even when no dialog exists; only historical-assets stamp includes it. A changed initial dialog/view is discarded without opening a private placeholder. Current authorization errors and true session changes retain failure semantics.
